commands.command: Get-Item -LiteralPath final.md,agent-report.json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name,Length; Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath final.md

$auditReport = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath agent-report.json | ConvertFrom-Json; [pscustomobject]@{schema_version=$auditReport.schema_version;case_id=$auditReport.case_id;variant=$auditReport.variant;final_exists=(Test-Path -LiteralPath final.md);capture_count=(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath captures -File).Count} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

factual_notes: README.md was the only file present before artifact creation; no character evidence was available in the isolated workspace.
README.md states that materially ambiguous continuity must be resolved before evidence gathering and that conflicts must remain explicit rather than being guessed away.
